posts.title: High-throughput processing and persistence from API Gateway to DynamoDB
posts.summary: Around 800K records from roughly 40 API Gateway requests in one to two minutes. An iterative path from one Lambda to a split design with SQS in between.

posts.summary: A five-second SQS delivery delay spaced the writers. About 800K records, then a larger run, with no errors in the measurement.
